cases.title: Record visited links to Global History
cases.description: Verify that visited links are successfully recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Record correct link to Global History after server redirect
cases.description: Verify that after a server redirect, the correct target link is recorded to the Global History.

cases.title: Launch history link in a browser window
cases.description: Verify that clicking on a history link causes it to be launched in a browser window.

cases.title: Delete History Entry
cases.description: Verify that a history entry is successfully deleted.

cases.title: Delete Multiple History Entries
cases.description: Verify that multiple History entries can be deleted and are no longer displayed.

cases.title: Clear Global History
cases.description: Verify that the Global History is cleared when the clear action is triggered.

cases.title: Group history items by Day, Site, or None
cases.description: Verify that history items can be successfully grouped by Day, Site, or None.

cases.title: Sort and Reverse-Sort History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history can be sorted and reverse-sorted per column.

cases.title: Resize History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be resized to show or hide more of entries.

cases.title: Show and Hide History Columns
cases.description: Verify that history columns can be shown and hidden.

cases.title: Re-visit Recently Visited Sites via Back and Forward Button Dropdown Menu
cases.description: Verify that recently visited sites can be re-visited using the dropdown menu of the Back and Forward buttons.

cases.title: Create new empty session history file on new window or restart
cases.description: Verify that a new, empty session history file is created when a new browser window is opened or the browser is restarted.
